_comment: Go-specialist bottom-tier experiment (2:1:1 fan-out). Tier 0 is Llama 4 Maverick 17B — the cheapest strong non-Claude coder on this Bedrock account (no true Go-only specialist exists there). Its prices are the REAL us-west-2 on-demand rates from the AWS Pricing API ($0.24/MTok in, $0.97/MTok out), ~4x cheaper than Haiku. Mid/large keep Claude at the same illustrative list prices every prior run used, so cross-run cost comparison holds. test_model=sonnet-4-6 differs from every tier (invariant #3). Fan-out 2:1:1 restores multi-sample behavioural clustering at the cheap tier (1:1:1 starved it) while staying far below the default 5:2:1.
